personal.name: Kiishi DAVID
personal.title: Mobile Applications Developer
personal.tagline: Building scalable, high-performance mobile applications with Flutter

bio: I am a Mobile Applications Developer specializing in Flutter, with a strong focus on building scalable, highly-optimized, and cross-platform applications.

Based in Lagos, Nigeria, I have extensive experience in developing fintech products, telecommunications apps, and educational platforms. I'm passionate about clean architecture, state management, and delivering seamless user experiences.
My expertise includes Dart, Firebase, REST APIs, and integrating complex features like QR code payments, eSIM provisioning, and real-time data synchronization.

experience.description: Developed and maintained a high-performance telecommunications mobile application enabling global eSIM purchases and phone number rentals.
achievements: Developed and maintained a high-performance telecommunications mobile application enabling global eSIM purchases, phone number rentals, and SMS verification services across 100+ countries.
Implemented secure wallet and payment workflows integrating Paystack for NGN transactions, featuring real-time balance tracking and automated top-ups.
Integrated third-party telecommunications APIs for eSIM provisioning and virtual number services, ensuring compliance with international telecom standards.
Collaborated with a cross-functional team to deliver key features on time, including real-time eSIM data capacity monitoring and automated renewal systems.
Architected a clean, modular Flutter application using Riverpod state management and repository pattern.

experience.description: Developed and maintained a high-performance fintech mobile application for seamless money transfers between Nigerian banks.
achievements: Developed and maintained a high-performance fintech mobile application for seamless money transfers between Nigerian banks.

Collaborated with a cross-functional team to deliver key features on time, such as real-time payment tracking and multi-account management.
Integrated third-party APIs and ensured compliance with Nigerian financial regulations and industry standards.
Built a payment SDK that synchronizes with the mobile transactions experience provided by the Mona app.
